snippet.title: PlayStation - Sound Novel Evolution 2 - Kamaitachi no Yoru - Tokubetsu Hen (1998)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Kamaitachi no Yoru: Tokubetsu-Hen is an Adventure game, developed by Astroll and published by ChunSoft, which was released in Japan in 1998.
